title: Argus: verifying bibliographies against Crossref to detect distorted citations
description: Argus checks a bibliography against the authoritative Crossref record for each work and flags citations whose metadata does not match, including the co-author conflation (a real paper cited with the byline of another) that DOI resolution and first-author checks miss. It reads CSL-JSON or BibTeX, depends only on the Python standard library and the public Crossref API, and contains no language model in its verification path.
